types.name: Summit Chaser
types.description: You go for the pass, not the café. Early starts and big days are your thing.

types.name: Slow Wanderer
types.description: Three nights in one village beats seven places in a week. You travel to feel a place.

types.name: Foodie Nomad
types.description: Your itinerary is really a list of dhabas, siddu stalls and bakeries.

types.name: Budget Backpacker
types.description: Local buses, dorm beds and shared taxis. You make ₹5,000 go a very long way.

types.name: Photographer
types.description: You'll wait an hour for the light. Sunrise, blue hour and the Milky Way are your schedule.

types.name: Spiritual Seeker
types.description: Monasteries, temples and quiet mornings. The journey inward matters as much as the trail.
